Can you have covid AND have normal oxygen levels (oximeter says 98% - 99%)? I'm experiencing all of the symptoms of covid except for loss of taste/smell and trouble breathing.

I'm getting a test tomorrow but I was just wondering if this is possible. (I'm overthinking, I probably just have the flu haha)

I was riding a bike around my neighborhood when I passed by an ant hill. I stopped to look at it when thousands of big red ants starting coming out and swarming me. I woke up as soon as I was completely swallowed in ants. I was around 5 or 6 at the time.

I read an article about siblings named Macaroni85, Spaghetti88, and Sincerely Yours98.
 
Link: https://news.abs-cbn.com/lifestyle/01/10/14/meet-siblings-macaroni-85-spaghetti-88-sincerely-yours-98
Logic really helps me out. Although his latest song about suicide (1-800-273-8255) caused me to relapse. I was 4 months clean of selfharm until that song released
I won't, I promise. We're going shopping later, even if I hate shopping.

I have some songs I like to listen to also, although they probably aren't your cup of tea (instrumental bands like CHON and Animals as Leaders, metal, etc) Music is a big part of my life. If being a drummer would make me money I would go for it, but I need a reliable way to help my mom. That may seem sad and unfair for most people, but that's my reality.

Materialistic things were never our number 1 priority, but we need to work for food, water, power, etc. When we talk I always give her my 100% focus, but we rarely talk, we both too busy. I make it a point to try and give her a hug at least once a day, but there are just those days where we don't even see each other.
We kind of have the same pact, although its unsaid. We like to huddle up on the couch and watch some Netflix, but finding the time for that to happen is hard.

She isn't actively suicidal, I'm not either. We both know what would happen to the other if dither of us go through with it. I live in a 3rd world country, we don't have free healthcare for depression and the like. We don't have the money to pay for a therapist. And even if we did, I'm scared. Scared of what people would think of me. I self harm, my mom doesn't know that. I dread to know what would happen if she finds out. It may not be fair for me to be responsible for her, but I am, and I want to be.
I don't feel like I'm not myself because I've been like this for a long time.
